text: Fernbridge's scan and GPS events flow through Kafka, but only live there a few hours. This video builds the first pipeline piece: a Structured Streaming job landing every event, untouched, into Bronze.
Bronze has one job: read the Kafka topic, parse each event against a defined schema, and append it to Delta. No cleaning, no dedup, no business logic -- that restraint is the whole point.
The job reads fernbridge.delivery-events and parses the JSON payload against an explicit schema -- nothing here filters a row or resolves an ID. That's Silver's job, next video.

Every row writes append-only to fernbridge.bronze.raw_delivery_events, stamped with kafka_ingest_timestamp and _source_offset, so any later layer can be reprocessed from this exact raw record if something ever looks wrong.
Every scan and GPS ping now has a permanent home. Next: cleaning it up and resolving it against Fernbridge's real vehicle and driver records in Silver.
